QuestInfo.name: [Museum Master] Become the Maple Museum Master
QuestInfo.0: Various mysterious collectibles have appeared in Maple World. Talk to Cassandra and she'll open your personal museum where you can store these collectibles.
QuestInfo.1: Listen to Cassandra as she explains the details about your personal museum.
QuestInfo.2: You listened to Cassandra's explanation and have opened your own personal museum to store your collectibles.
